en: Who's there?\nQuit listening in on us!
Excuse me!\nThis is a private conversation!
There aren't many bugs out here.
I like bugs, so I'm going back to\nVIRIDIAN FOREST.
Huh?\nYou want to talk to me?
This stinks…\nI couldn't beat your challenge…
I should bring more POKéMON with\nme. I'll feel safer that way.
I want to get stronger.\nWhat's your secret?
I've never seen you around.\nAre you good?
Are my POKéMON weak?\nOr, am I just bad?\lWhich do you think?
